result.summary: Found several visual issues: truncated restaurant names and delivery text, overlapping/garbled delivery time on a popular listing, and cut-off category chips and cards at the screen edges.

issues.description: Delivery info under Tokumaru Ramen Bar is garbled/overlapping as '25-30delivery' with the time range and 'delivery' running together and partially obscured.
issues.suggestion: Fix layout so delivery time and label have proper spacing (e.g. '25–30 min · delivery') and do not overlap or clip.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated on the Fastest near you card, cutting off the full name.
issues.suggestion: Allow wrapping, reduce font size, or ensure cards show full names with ellipsis only when necessary and consistent truncation.

issues.description: Category filter chips are cut off on the right (partial chip visible after Healthy), suggesting horizontal scroll without clear affordance.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate padding/fade hint for scrollable chips or fit primary filters without harsh clipping.

issues.description: Rightmost 'Fastest near you' card is partially cut off at the screen edge.
issues.suggestion: Add consistent horizontal padding and peek of the next card so the carousel does not look broken.

issues.description: Bottom popular pizza card is heavily cropped with only the top portion visible, which can look incomplete.
issues.suggestion: Adjust scroll/viewport so cards have balanced visible height or clearer section spacing above the tab bar.
